finalText:
This confirms the earlier list is complete — no multiline two-arg calls hiding anywhere. `ledger.js`, `dashboard.js`, and `refunds.js` don't use the legacy form at all.

**17 call sites** still pass the legacy second argument (excluding the `formatAmount` definition itself in `src/lib/format.js`), spread across 7 files:

| File | Count |
|---|---|
| `src/reports/quarterly.js` | 5 |
| `src/admin/exports.js` | 3 |
| `src/billing/invoice.js` | 3 |
| `src/checkout/cart.js` | 2 |
| `src/reports/monthly.js` | 2 |
| `src/checkout/receipt.js` | 1 |
| `src/billing/statement.js` | 1 |

`src/reports/quarterly.js` has the most, with 5 call sites (lines 16, 37, 58, 83, 104) all passing `true`. All 17 sites pass a literal `true` — no dynamic values — so dropping the parameter should be a mechanical strip-the-second-arg change everywhere.
